Task ID
IMP-01

Title
Create the PPAP Objects and workflow stages

Category
Object setup

Objective
Provide the Objects and stage names needed before related PPAP features can be configured.

Detailed scope
Create the 25 new non-catalogue Objects and the separate target PPAP, element and drawing-review workflow stages. Add the target-record marker on the existing PPAP. These early outputs let later assignments create links in both directions without circular build dependencies.

Deliverable
New PPAP Objects, new stage/termination entries and the target-record marker.

Work needed first
None

What is waiting
Partly waiting: Objects and the target marker can be created; selecting the separate workflow for new target records waits for the supported native method.

Recommended implementer role
Senior Associate Consultant

Recommended reviewer/approver role
Senior Consultant — PPAP build reviewer (a different person)

Why this role is recommended
The assignment combines established field, related-list and form settings. A Senior Associate Consultant can apply the conditions consistently, with the separate build reviewer checking their effect on the wider process.

Target PPAP workflow
Create Draft, In Progress and Management Review stages; set initial stage=Draft. Create Approved as a completed termination and Cancelled as a cancelled termination. Keep historical PPAP/APQP workflow definitions unchanged. Add no Interim Approval, withdrawal or closed-package reopen action. Consequential actions and responsibility rules are added by their owning process assignments before the target creation path is connected.

PPAP Element workflow
Create Work In Progress and Engineer Review stages; set initial stage=Work In Progress. Create Approved as completed and Cancelled as cancelled termination entries. Excluded requirements have no operational workflow.

PPAP Drawing Review workflow
Create Engineering Review stage and set it as initial. Create Review Complete with completed termination type. Do not add an Exception stage for transport failures.

PPAP.Target Configuration?
Set the type to Yes/No (Boolean). Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: FALSE for existing; TRUE for target create path only. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; hidden. Field/control lifecycle: Target Create handler sets TRUE before guarded shared handlers run; never toggle after creation.

Build instructions
1. Set Target Configuration? to FALSE for ordinary existing records and allow only the proposed target creation action to write TRUE when creating a new target PPAP. Prevent later manual/API/import changes to that marker.
2. Create workflow/stage identities without attaching the new process to historical PPAP or APQP records. The creation connection will consume these new identities after its remaining checks are configured.

How to check the result
• The 25 new non-catalogue Objects exist and no shared supplier, identity, inspection or APQP Object has been recreated.
• A target workflow has only the named stages/terminations; historical PPAP/APQP instances still point to their existing workflow definitions.

Information needed for this task
IN-03: Supply the supported target-only workflow selection and stage setup method; new Objects and the marker can be created before the target creation connection is completed.

Supplied input context
• IN-03 — Supported target workflow and shared-handler connection: The technical team must supply the supported way to select a new PPAP-only workflow for target records, read the PPAP-only Target Configuration? field from shared handlers, set it before legacy handlers run, and resolve the direct/inherited Id name collision. The plan assigns the resulting configuration changes, not a tenant-verification exercise.
